tasks.instruction: Pytania wlasne do mapy mysli OJAJ 2026/27 o Wielkiej Brytanii (nie z arkusza olimpiady). Z podanych odpowiedzi wybierz poprawna. Tylko jedna jest prawidlowa.

items.stem: On which ship did Charles Darwin sail around the world?
Which book by Charles Darwin set out the theory of evolution by natural selection?
options: A) On the Origin of Species
B) A Brief History of Time
C) The Descent of the Planets

items.stem: Why is Ada Lovelace often called the first computer programmer?
options: A) She built the first electronic computer.
B) She invented the World Wide Web.
C) She broke the Enigma code in the Second World War.
D) She wrote a program for Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine.

items.stem: What did Emmeline Pankhurst fight for?
options: A) the end of the slave trade
B) the right of women to vote
C) free schools for all children

items.stem: What was the motto of the suffragettes led by Emmeline Pankhurst?
options: A) Keep calm and carry on
